name: Leg Day

gist.Arnold, the Maximum Lotl: Gains health and Attack permanently with every Ability attached to him.
gist.Alex, Trainer of Heroes: When he gains an Ability, he fetches another from the deck for a team-mate, twice a turn.
gist.Ghuanjun, the Undead Martial Artist: May make up to three different attacks in a turn if nobody else acts; his targets cannot drop below one health that turn.
gist.Training: Ability: extra Ability attachments each turn.
gist.Toughness: Ability: a large block of extra health per level.
gist.Muscle Training: A free "attack" that fetches a Fighting and attaches it.
gist.Quick Attack: A free first attack each turn.
gist.Ferocious Tiger Kick: Attack that stuns; better as the second attack of the turn.
gist.Strong Ox Headbutt: Attack that makes you discard; better as the second attack.
gist.Whirlwind Strike: Hits two of your heroes at once; needs Fighting at level three.
gist.Club of Gobbo: Equipment: more Attack, and the damage cannot be reduced or cancelled.
gist.Cloud Pillow: Halves the damage one of her heroes takes for a turn.
gist.Escape: Reaction: discards a card to cancel an attack or spell that would defeat a hero.

plan: Coach Rox trains. For the first turns she does nothing but attach Abilities: Alex hands spares to his team-mates, Training allows several a turn, and Arnold grows bigger with each one. Then three enormous heroes with Fighting at level three take turns: Heavy Hit to stun, Quick Attack on top, Whirlwind Strike across two heroes, Ghuanjun softening everyone up with three attacks in a turn. There is nothing clever in it and almost nothing to interact with, which is its strength; its weakness is that every bit of damage is an attack by a hero, announced, one target at a time, and that the build-up takes turns.

looks.early: Ability stacks rising on all three heroes; no attack yet.
looks.mid: Arnold twice his printed size on a Warhorse, a stun on your caster every turn.
looks.late: Three walls of health with Fighting three, taking turns to hit two of your heroes at once.

opening.tell: She is attaching Abilities three at a time and has not attacked once.
opening.why: Racing heroes that gain a block of health every turn is hopeless, but her slow start is free time: build the Storm and set Firewall, which burns whoever finally attacks for the rest of the duel.

midgame.tell: Arnold swings once a turn with Heavy Hit and your caster is stunned every time.
midgame.why: Her damage is one announced attack at a time: Tea the stun back, freeze the attacker of the turn, shield the big hit, and keep the Storm and burns ticking on all three. There is nothing to sweep.

crisis.tell: Fighting has reached level three and Ghuanjun is winding up for a turn of three attacks.
crisis.why: Flashbang ends her turn after the first action, which wrecks a multi-attack turn; Snow Cannon does the same to a single hero. Another turn of pure building will not survive Whirlwind Strike.

endgame.tell: Her last hero is huge but has been burning from Firewall and ticking under the Storm for many turns.
endgame.why: Health is all she has; unreducible damage (Acid Vial) and the doubled Storm outpace one attack a turn, and Escape only works if she still has a card to discard.

Muscle Training, another Fighting; still no real attack.
Arnold has three Abilities and a Warhorse.
